race.comment: OCEANS BLUE (11) resumes. She debuted in a good maiden at Bendigo and was heavily supported to start at $2.45. She ran a good race there and is expected to improve second time around. Happy to have on top, especially with a lot of key dangers coming out. OUR BEE GEE (16) was well beaten on debut at Caulfield Heath but can improve sharply into this for the Begg/Childs combination. RENTIER (9) wasn't far away on debut at Tatura after showing speed. He should come on from that and will give some cheek. LIGHTWATCH (4) didn't fire fresh on heavy but was hard in the market there and can bounce back quickly.
